messages.text: The reference review reinforces that the source’s image-first masonry and restrained overlay hierarchy should remain dominant; analytics should be a separate scan-oriented route, not decorative cards mixed into the gallery. I’m now fixing the data schema and route boundaries first, then I’ll connect generated, locally served prompt media to those seeded records so the final app has neither remote-image fragility nor equal-height placeholders.
